proposals.title: Audit proxy sampling before interpreting spatial rankings
proposals.claim: First-row proxy sampling can change neighborhood_mmd rankings solely through acquisition ordering; a seeded whole-cloud sampling audit will detect such dependence.
proposals.mechanism: The proxy uses at most 150 leading rows. Spatially ordered storage can select a localized region, changing neighborhood_mmd through local mixture and neighbor density without changing the full embryo.
proposals.falsifier: When authorized data and scorer exist, permute row order while preserving X-coordinate pairing. Reject material order dependence if component rankings remain stable across matched samples and embryos.

evidence.says: Proxy selects candidate[:n] and true[:n], with n at most 150, and passes paired expression and coordinates to score_t2.

proposals.title: Verify expression-position sensitivity independently of geometry
proposals.claim: A metric contract suite can distinguish expression-position coupling errors from coordinate-frame effects before any biological model is trained.
proposals.mechanism: Check neighborhood_mmd under expression-row permutation at fixed coordinates, rigid transforms, and isotropic scaling; separately inspect d2_shape, occupancy_dice, scale_log_ratio and mmd_u responses.
proposals.falsifier: On a synthetic cloud with separated expression domains, reject the suite if it misses destroyed pairing or mislabels rigid-motion and uniform-scale effects; verify actual scorer tolerances when available.

evidence.says: Validation checks exact panel, bounds, expression values and coordinate shape/finite values, without a joint expression-position diagnostic.

evidence.ref: Jones et al. Alignment of spatial genomics data using deep Gaussian processes. Nature Methods 2023. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-023-01972-2
evidence.says: GPSA separates mapping observed locations to common coordinates from mapping coordinates to phenotypic readouts; this motivates auditing frame and expression effects separately.

peer_responses.on: Actual challenge to sampling and pairing controls in spatialtx-r1-1 and spatialtx-r1-2
peer_responses.because: agent_orchestrator.py:175-185 samples before absent scoring. Separate storage-order effects from subset-rebuilt neighbors; freeze type mixture for within-type shuffles, perturb segmentation separately, and require imaging provenance for correction.

self_correction: Seeded whole-cloud sampling does not preserve full-cloud neighborhoods when the scorer rebuilds neighbors after thinning. Add fixed-neighborhood versus rebuilt-neighborhood diagnostics; transformation controls establish sensitivity, not biological causes.
declined: Default nonlinear expression-guided registration could erase real developmental deformation. Anchor inversion could recover forbidden target properties. Neither is a justified preprocessing strategy.
